title: fix(app-shell): New package derives and checks the Package ID; New object previews the saved name (objectui#11792)
body:
Fixes #11792

Clause-②: no

Studio's *New package* dialog now fills in the Package ID from the display name and refuses an id the server would refuse. *New object* now shows the name the object is saved under.

## What changed

- **`PackageFormDialog`, create mode only.**
  - The Package ID field is the shared `PackageIdInput`, the same input the landing page's Duplicate form uses. It lowercases, drops unsupported characters and says so, and explains the format while the id is invalid.
  - Typing a display name fills the id as `com.ORG.NAME`. ORG is the active organization's slug; with no active organization the segment is left out, giving `com.NAME`. Once the author types into the id field, it stops following the name. The object namespace keeps following the id, as before.
  - *Create package* is enabled only for an id that `ManifestSchema.shape.id` from the installed `@objectstack/spec` accepts. That is the declaration `POST /api/v1/packages` refuses by. Before this change any non-empty id was enough, so `Repairs Center` was posted and refused with a 400.
  - Edit and view mode are unchanged. They still render the spec form's locked id field, and edit still PATCHes only name, description and version. A test pins both.
- **`PackageIdInput`.** Three optional props:
  - `id`, so a host's label can name the input;
  - `rule`, the predicate together with its two sentences;
  - `inputClassName`, so the dialog can size the input like its other fields.

  The landing Duplicate form passes none of them and keeps `PACKAGE_ID_RE` and its own sentences.
- **`CreateItemDialog`.** One optional prop, `storedName`. When it is set, the dialog previews the name the item is saved under, below the identifier field. `onSubmit` still receives the bare identifier. The app, automation and access dialogs pass nothing, so they render as before; a test pins that.
- **Data pillar *New object* call site.** It passes `prefixObjectName` over the same `namespace` state that `doCreateObject` saves with. The preview reads `repairs_repair_ticket` for `repair_ticket`.
- **New i18n rows, en and zh**, in the metadata-admin designer table. They are under two prefixes no in-flight card uses: `engine.packages.idRule.*` (three rows) and `engine.studio.createItem.*` (one row).
- **Changeset:** a patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`. Nothing is added to the package entry.

## The three hypotheses, measured

- **H1: does `PACKAGE_ID_RE` agree with the server? No, and it is wrong in both directions.**
  - The two sources:
    - client: `PACKAGE_ID_RE` in `packages-io`;
    - server: `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` in objectstack `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts` on objectstack `origin/main` `51290bca`.
  - The server enforces the pattern through `ManifestSchema.shape.id.safeParse`, in `installPackage` in `metadata-protocol`'s `protocol.ts`, before anything is installed.
  - The installed spec, 17.7.0, carries the same pattern.
  - The client accepts ids the spec refuses: `com.acme.my_app`, `com.-x`, `a..b` and `com._x`.
  - The client refuses an id the spec accepts: `163.com.crm`.
  - So the dialog does not judge by `PACKAGE_ID_RE`. It reuses the input with the spec's own predicate passed in, which keeps the claim's rule: "the client never refuses an id the server accepts, nor accepts one it refuses".
  - `PACKAGE_ID_RE` itself, and the landing Duplicate form that uses it, are **left as they are**. They are reported below under Acceptance notes, not aligned here.
  - The new test reads every probe's verdict from the installed schema. It also asserts that its probe list separates the two grammars in both directions, so the probes cannot quietly stop testing that.
- **H2: where does ORG come from? `useAuth().activeOrganization?.slug` from `@object-ui/auth`. It is not always present.**
  - It is null outside an `AuthProvider`, because the provider-less default carries no organization. It is also null when the session has no active organization, or before the organization list has loaded.
  - The server declares no grammar for the slug: `sys_organization.slug` is free text with `maxLength: 255`. So the slug is folded into one id segment, and dropped if nothing usable remains.
  - When the organization arrives after the name was typed, an id that is still following the name picks it up.
  - No segment is invented, and no server read is added.
- **H3: where is the prefix applied? On the client, not the server.**
  - `doCreateObject` saves `prefixObjectName(rawName, namespace)`. The decision inside it is the spec's `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`.
  - The server does not prefix on draft save. At publish it refuses a name without the prefix (`NAMESPACE_PREFIX`), using the registry manifest's namespace.
  - The preview calls the same function on the same state, so it shows exactly what is stored.
  - One case to know: the namespace lookup (`fetchPackages`) is best-effort and asynchronous. While it is pending, or after it fails, the preview and the save both use the bare identifier. Publish then refuses that name.
  - The legacy double-underscore form cannot reach the rule from this dialog, because `toFieldName` collapses a double underscore.

## Tests and gates

All the runs below are on `e40f54d`, which is `origin/main` `455c646` merged in.

| Command | Verdict |
| --- | --- |

| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` | `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` shows both new test files in the test program. |
| `pnpm exec vitest run` over the 10 `PackageFormDialog` / `CreatePackageDialog` / `EditPackageDialog` / `PackagesPage` test files, including the new `PackageFormDialog.idDerive-11792.test.tsx` | `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 119 passed (119)` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run` over 18 files that render the touched components (listed below) | `Test Files 18 passed (18)`, `Tests 77 passed (77)` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | exit 0 |

| `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity` | exit 0 |

The 18 files in the Studio run:
- `studio-locale.i18n`;
- `BuilderLanding.orgScope-11553`;
- `CreateItemDialog.storedName-11792`;
- `PackageIdInput`;
- the ten `DataPillar.*` files;
- `StudioDesignSurface.createAppAccessibleName`, `.createObjectOwd`, `.draftVersionConflict-11773` and `.emptyPackage`.

**Declared narrowing:** the whole `studio-design/` directory (99 files) was started once. It was cut off by the queue budget of the shared verify lock after it acquired the lock, so it is **NOT MEASURED** here. The 18 files are those that render `PackageFormDialog`, `PackageIdInput`, `CreateItemDialog`, `BuilderLanding` or the Data pillar's *New object*, found by `grep` over the test tree. CI runs the full set.

**Ablation, run once and not kept as a test**, on `e40f54d` through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which wraps the run and restores the file when it ends:
- Two mutations together:
  - the create gate goes back to the pre-fix non-empty check;
  - the call site's `storedName` prop is deleted.
- Result: `Tests 6 failed | 19 passed (25)`, the red direction expected.
  - The failures are the `Repairs Center` case, the three spec-refused probes (`com.acme.my_app`, `com.-x`, `a..b`) and both Data pillar end-to-end cases.
- Both restores were checked:
  - the file's blob hash equals its blob hash at `HEAD`;
  - `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not delivered from the card's Expected, on purpose:**
  - *Namespace editable while the package is empty.* This is a contract question, not a client fix. The form marks `namespace` as `immutable`, and the REST PATCH persists only name, description and version.
  - *Namespace visible in the package sheet*, and *Version and Type under Advanced.* These are outside the direction triage set in comment 6042100863, which was the body's three suggested steps.
- **Placement.** `SchemaForm` has no slot for rendering one field yourself, and `SchemaForm.tsx` is outside this claim's file surface. So the create-mode id row sits above the spec form, and the Basics section opens with Display name. A help line under the id says it is filled in from the display name.
- **The claim said one optional prop on `PackageIdInput`; this adds three** (`id`, `rule`, `inputClassName`). All three are optional and internal. None is on the package entry.
- **Reported, not changed here: the landing Duplicate form disagrees with the spec's id rule.** It gates on `PACKAGE_ID_RE`, and its stripped-characters notice says underscores are allowed.
  - Measured with a temporary render of the real `BuilderLanding`, deleted afterwards:
    - `163.com.crm` is disabled with the format hint, although the spec accepts it;
    - `com.acme.my_app` and `com.-x` are enabled, although the spec refuses them.
  - The duplicate route passes through the same `installPackage` id gate, so those two would come back as a 400. That part is read from the source, not measured live.
  - This goes back to the PM seat to file, per the dispatch rule against aligning it quietly.

## Overlap with in-flight cards

In `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` this adds one prop at the Data pillar's *New object* `CreateItemDialog` call site and nothing else. objectui#11781, objectui#11785, objectui#11788 and objectui#11790 edit other regions. `origin/main` `455c646` is merged in.
